event: He gives ground on purpose, backing toward the narrow neck to the cleared hall.
To follow him they must give up the flank and funnel into the one throat of stone.
He pours the heaviest wave he can raise down the lane; it bites both, and they reel.

changes.note: The heaviest wave he can raise on what is left

event: He turns and runs; the trailing one lunges through the flames and rakes his back.

changes.note: A deep raking blow from behind as he flees
The fighting retreat and the run

event: Across the dead hall he throws himself onto the threshold-stone, and the wrongness ends.
Bleeding and burned low, he is out: the haven shut at his front, the way down open behind.
